stances.summary: Advocates for organizing security and worker privacy protections
stances.quote: first bit of advice I always give to anyone organizing: don't use your work email address, your employer has access to it! now written into policy in Britain (this is good)

stances.summary: Characterizes Trump plan as restrictive immigration, mass incarceration, and rollback of women's rights
stances.quote: I said at a panel earlier this summer that the Trump plan amounted to "deport all the immigrants, put a bunch of people in jail, push women back into the home and the white men can have the jobs that are left" and it was flip but also...accurate.
